title: Rav Bibi and the Angel of Death
summary: The Gemara's story of Rav Bibi bar Abaye, who heard from the Angel of Death of a woman taken by mistake, and the questions it raises about people taken before their time. Then the verses that made the Amoraim cry: that Hashem judges hidden and revealed deeds alike, and how careful a person must be not to embarrass another.
key_ideas: The Gemara tells of Rav Bibi bar Abaye and the Angel of Death, who took the wrong woman.
Some are taken before their time, "swept away without judgment."
Hashem brings every deed to judgment, hidden and revealed, which made Rabbi Yochanan cry.
A person must be careful never to embarrass another.
